mods.title: 1789: The French Revolution
mods.author: Frontline
mods.description: Revolution breaks out in Paris while kings rule everywhere else. The Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth still stands, Venice and Genoa are free republics, Russia and Austria are at war with the Ottomans, Sweden fights Russia, and the young United States has just sworn in George Washington.

mods.title: 1812: Napoleon Marches on Russia
mods.author: Frontline
mods.tagline: 24 June 1812 · The Grande Armée crosses the Niemen
mods.description: Napoleon's empire stretches from Hamburg to Rome and his allies cover Europe. Now 600,000 men cross into Russia. Britain fights on in Spain with Portugal and the Cádiz Regency, the United States has just declared war on Britain, and Spanish America is rising for independence.

mods.title: 1821: The Greek War of Independence
mods.author: Frontline
mods.tagline: 25 March 1821 · Greece rises against the Ottomans
mods.description: The Greeks of the Morea raise the flag of revolution against the Ottoman Empire. The Holy Alliance of Russia, Austria and Prussia keeps watch over a restored Europe, Spanish America is breaking free, and Muhammad Ali's Egypt grows into a power of its own.

mods.title: 1861: The American Civil War
mods.author: Frontline
mods.tagline: 12 April 1861 · The guns fire on Fort Sumter
mods.description: The Confederacy opens fire on Fort Sumter and America tears itself apart. Italy has just been proclaimed a kingdom, Germany is still a patchwork around Prussia and Austria, Russia frees its serfs, the Taiping hold half of southern China, and Britain rules India.

mods.title: Cold War 1962: The Cuban Missile Crisis
mods.author: Frontline
mods.tagline: 16 October 1962 · Soviet missiles are found in Cuba
mods.description: Thirteen days on the edge of nuclear war: American spy planes have found Soviet missiles in Cuba. Berlin is walled in, Vietnam is divided, the Congo is at war with Katanga, Yemen's revolution has turned into civil war, and China and India are about to clash in the Himalayas.

mods.title: Cold War 1985
mods.author: Frontline
mods.tagline: 11 March 1985 · Gorbachev takes power in Moscow
mods.description: The height of the Cold War: NATO against the Warsaw Pact across a divided Germany, the Soviet Union bogged down in Afghanistan, Iran and Iraq locked in a bloody war, and civil war in Angola. One spark could turn it hot.

mods.title: Empires Reborn
mods.author: Frontline
mods.tagline: 1 January 2031 · The old empires are back
mods.description: An alternate 2031 where the great empires of history have returned on today's map — the Ottomans and Byzantium face off over the Aegean, Austria-Hungary and the Holy Roman Empire rule central Europe, a Russian Empire stretches to the Pacific, and Persia, Mali, the Inca and Gran Colombia rise again.

mods.title: The Shattered Isles
mods.author: Frontline
mods.description: A whole new planet of ragged continents and countless islands: 60 nations from the vast Federation of Kingland to tiny island realms, two rival blocs — the Northern Compact and the Sunward League — and a border war already burning. Nothing here is on any map of Earth.

mods.title: Supreme Command
mods.author: Frontline
mods.tagline: A dark WWII grand-strategy war room
mods.description: Charcoal steel panels with square frames and gold trim, condensed capitals and stencil titles, green command buttons, and a muted, painted strategy map: earthy country colours over strong terrain relief, heavy dark borders, a slate sea and an old-paper wash.
